body:
What changed: the MIX name database now hash-resolves all seven entries in the retail Yuri `SIDEC02MD.MIX`, via `BKGDSMY.SHP`, `BKGDMDY.SHP`, `BKGDLGY.SHP`, `RADARY.SHP`, `UIBKGDY.PAL`, `RADARYURI.PAL` and the shared `KEY.INI`. The Allied `BKGD` background plates are also in the database, so `mix-dump names` resolves them in `SIDEC01.MIX` and `SIDEC02.MIX` too. A retail corpus test decodes every Yuri SHP frame and parses both palettes. Yuri gameplay and its sidebar remain unwired.

How it was verified:
- `cargo test --workspace` passed, all suites green.
- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
- `cargo fmt --check` passed.
- `mix-dump scan` on all retail archives reported zero errors.
- `mix-dump names SIDEC02MD.MIX` now names 7 of 7 entries, where it previously named 0 of 7.
- New retail test `yuri_side_archive_is_fully_named_and_decodes` passed on the local install.

Proof, via headless `mix-dump render` with the newly named palettes (same decode code as the corpus test, retail art kept outside git):
- Draft release: https://github.com/johnnyhuy/openyr/releases/tag/untagged-f33e874239718b014faf
- `bkgdlgy.png`: `BKGDLGY.SHP` (856x736) rendered with `UIBKGDY.PAL`, showing the purple Yuri plate.
- `radary.png`: `RADARY.SHP` frames rendered with `RADARYURI.PAL`, showing the Yuri radar sweep.

Reviewer notes: name resolution is hash confirmation against retail entry IDs, following the existing name database method in `docs/formats/mix.md`. The two unresolved menu IDs in `SIDEC01.MIX` (125x25 controls, 856x32 header) remain unnamed. No retail assets are committed.
